name: zotero-mcp
description: Zotero MCP: Connects your Zotero research library with Claude and other AI assistants via the Model Context Protocol to discuss papers, get summaries, analyze citations, and more.

issues.title: Feature request: rename an attachment's filename on disk, not just its title
`update-db` without `--fulltext` indexes every annotation, the SQLite path does not, and the mismatch never self-heals
Feature request: dedupe cross-library copies in semantic search results (with over-fetch so limit stays meaningful)
Feature request: batch processing support for Systematic Literature Reviews (SLRs)
Proposal: Decouple passage chunks from items by keying passages to attachment_key (#494, #495)
Attachment file helpers don't know which library they serve — group uploads go to the personal WebDAV
classify_pdf() raises "Invalid PDF structure" on a CNKI-produced PDF while PyMuPDF reads it fine (v1.20.0)
PDF attach silently fails on free-tier cloud quota (HTTP 413) for local-storage users without WebDAV — propose connector-endpoint fallback

discussions.title: Is there a way to limit semantic search to a subset of our whole library?
Gemini CLI / Claude Desktop x Zotero MCP Remote Setup
Is Codex App able to access this MCP?
Is it possible to add support for exporting bibtex reference?

latest_release.name: v0.17.1
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* chore(plugin): updates.json for 0.17.0 by @54yyyu in https://github.com/54yyyu/zotero-mcp/pull/815
* test: flush a simulated writer's ChromaDB files before migrating by @54yyyu in https://github.com/54yyyu/zotero-mcp/pull/816
* Release 0.17.1 by @54yyyu in https://github.com/54yyyu/zotero-mcp/pull/829
* fix: keep a closing bracket the DOI opened in embedded page metadata (#817) by @goranai in https://github.com/54yyyu/zotero-mcp/pull/818
* feat(batch): support passage chunking on the Batch API path (#416) by @mronkko in https://github.com/54yyyu/zotero-mcp/pull/819
* feat(setup): ask for WebDAV settings; fix(copy): write copied files to WebDAV by @ShoRoy in https://github.com/54yyyu/zotero-mcp/pull/820
* docs: add VS Code and Copilot setup instructions by @kskszq in https://github.com/54yyyu/zotero-mcp/pull/821
* docs(plugin): recommend .exe for custom agents on Windows by @kskszq in https://github.com/54yyyu/zotero-mcp/pull/822
* fix(plugin): resolve the Windows Claude Code shim before ACP launch by @FFXFF1 in https://github.com/54yyyu/zotero-mcp/pull/827

## New Contributors
* @goranai made their first contribution in https://github.com/54yyyu/zotero-mcp/pull/818
* @ShoRoy made their first contribution in https://github.com/54yyyu/zotero-mcp/pull/820

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/54yyyu/zotero-mcp/compare/v0.17.0...v0.17.1
